subject: Re: Demo calendar — Crestline reassigns LLM workstream (please advise)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Carlson <ethan.carlson@crestline.com>
Cc: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@crestline.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Demo slot confirmation — 25 Oct at 11am PT

Hi Ethan / Alyssa,

Thanks again for the time on our call yesterday. Per our conversation, I booked a 45-minute demo for Monday, Oct 25 at 11:00am PT so we can walk through the Redwood Inference runtime, latency/cost tradeoffs, and a quick model-fit sketch for your document ingestion use case.

Agenda (proposed):
- 10m: quick goals and success criteria
- 20m: demo (routing, caching, Dedicated options)
- 10m: next steps / mutual action plan

I attached a short mutual action plan and the Q4 roadmap snapshot you asked for. If that slot won't work, happy to move; suggest a couple backup times the week of Nov 1.

Attachments: crestline-q4-roadmap.pdf, mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

From: Ethan Carlson <ethan.carlson@crestline.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@crestline.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo slot confirmation — 25 Oct at 11am PT

Thanks, Aditya.

Heads-up: we've had a sudden Q4 replan. Our VP of Product has pulled the LLM/inference initiative into a later sprint and is prioritizing an analytics rewrite for the next two months. Also, two of the engineers who would join the demo will be on travel the week of Oct 25. Between the rescope and the travel conflict, we need to deprioritize this workstream for now.

Can we pause the demo? If possible, put us on a follow‑up cadence for early January — we should have capacity after the analytics release. If you need an immediate answer for RN, please mark us as deferred to Q1.

Apologies — we reviewed your materials and we still want to see Redwood in action, just not this quarter. I've attached the security Q&A we'll need answered before an internal greenlight once we re-open the effort.

Attachment: crestline-security-reply.pdf

Best,
Ethan Carlson
Director of Platform Engineering
Crestline Logistics
ethan.carlson@crestline.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Carlson <ethan.carlson@crestline.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Demo slot confirmation — 25 Oct at 11am PT

Marissa / Naomi — forwarding Ethan's note. Crestline just told us they are pulling the inference workstream into a later sprint and two key engineers are traveling on the demo date. They asked to pause and re-engage in early Jan.

Questions:
- Do we offer a holding credit or reserved demo seat for deferred prospects like this?
- If we mark them as deferred to Q1, any reason to keep the calendar booking active (I suggested releasing the slot but adding them to a priority waitlist).
- Naomi — they attached a security questionnaire; want me to route to Trust & Security now or hold until they re-open?

Quick options I proposed to Ethan in reply (keeping it light):
1) Release the Oct slot, add Crestline to our Q1 follow-up list and set a calendar reminder for Jan 8.
2) Keep a placeholder on the calendar, but downgrade to a 15‑minute sync in Jan to triage the security questions asynchronously.
3) Offer a demo credit (one extended session) if they commit to a later pilot within 90 days.

Thoughts? If there's a standard approach we should apply for mid‑funnel accounts being pushed out by roadmap shifts, I'll follow that.

—Aditya

Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo calendar — Crestline reassigns LLM workstream (please advise)

Aditya — thanks for checking.

We reviewed your options internally and would prefer you release the Oct slot and add us to your Q1 follow-up queue. Please set a reminder for the week of Jan 10; by then we'll know whether to proceed with a pilot. For now, the right move for us is to focus engineering effort on the analytics rewrite.

If you're able to send a short note (1–2 bullets) summarizing the demo outcomes and an answer on the security questionnaire items we attached, that will help speed internal reprioritization when we re-open the work. We've attached a redline of the security doc with a few clarifying questions.

Thanks for being flexible. We'll expect a touchpoint in early Jan; please mark us as deferred to Q1 (not cancelled).

Attachments: crestline-security-reply.pdf (redline)

Best,
Ethan Carlson
Director of Platform Engineering
Crestline Logistics
